packages/ui-extensions/src/surfaces/poin.name: CartApi
packages/ui-extensions/src/surfaces/poin.description: The `CartApi` object provides access to cart management functionality and real-time cart state monitoring. Access these properties through `shopify.cart` to interact with the current POS cart.

packages/ui-extensions/src/surfaces/poin.name: CartApiContent

members.name: addAddress
members.description: Add a new address to the customer associated with the cart. The customer must be present in the cart before adding addresses with enhanced address validation and formatting.

members.name: addCartCodeDiscount
members.description: Apply a discount code to the cart. The system will validate the code and apply the appropriate discount if the code is valid and applicable to the current cart contents with improved error messaging.

members.name: addCartProperties
members.description: Add custom key-value properties to the cart for storing metadata, tracking information, or integration data. Properties are merged with existing cart properties with enhanced validation and conflict resolution.

members.name: addCustomSale
members.description: Add a custom sale item to the cart with specified quantity, title, price, and taxable status. Returns the `UUID` of the created line item for future operations and property management.

members.name: addLineItem
members.description: Add a product variant to the cart by its numeric `ID` with the specified quantity. Returns the `UUID` of the newly added line item, or an empty string if the user dismissed an oversell guard modal. Throws an error if POS fails to add the line item due to validation or system errors.

members.name: addLineItemProperties
members.description: Add custom properties to a specific line item using its `UUID`. Properties are merged with existing line item properties for metadata storage and tracking with enhanced validation.

members.name: addLineItemSellingPlan
members.description: Add a selling plan to a line item in the cart using the line item `UUID`, selling plan `ID`, and selling plan name. Optionally provide delivery interval and interval count for improved performance, otherwise POS will fetch them after syncing the cart.

members.name: applyCartDiscount
members.value: (type: CartDiscountType, title: string, amount?: string) => Promise<void>
members.description: Apply a cart-level discount with the specified type (`'Percentage'`, `'FixedAmount'`, or `'Code'`), title, and optional amount. For discount codes, omit the `amount` parameter. Enhanced validation ensures proper discount application.

members.name: bulkAddLineItemProperties
members.description: Add properties to multiple line items simultaneously using an array of inputs containing line item `UUIDs` and their respective properties for efficient bulk operations with enhanced validation and error reporting.

members.name: bulkCartUpdate
members.description: Perform a bulk update of the entire cart state including note, discounts, customer, line items, and properties. Returns the updated cart object after the operation completes with enhanced validation and error handling.

members.name: bulkSetLineItemDiscounts
members.description: Apply discounts to multiple line items simultaneously. Each input specifies the line item `UUID` and discount details for efficient bulk discount operations with enhanced validation and allocation tracking.

members.name: clearCart
members.description: Remove all line items and reset the cart to an empty state. This action can't be undone and will clear all cart contents including line items, discounts, properties, and selling plans.

members.name: current
members.description: Provides read-only access to the current cart state and allows subscribing to cart changes. The `value` property provides the current cart state, and `subscribe` allows listening to changes with improved performance and memory management.

members.name: deleteAddress
members.description: Delete an existing address from the customer using the address `ID`. The customer must be present in the cart to perform this operation with improved error handling for invalid address `IDs`.

members.name: removeAllDiscounts
members.description: Remove all discounts from both the cart and individual line items. Set `disableAutomaticDiscounts` to `true` to prevent automatic discounts from being reapplied after removal with enhanced discount allocation handling.

members.name: removeCartDiscount
members.description: Remove the current cart-level discount. This only affects cart-level discounts and does not impact line item discounts or automatic discount eligibility.

members.name: removeCartProperties
members.description: Remove specific cart properties by their keys. Only the specified property keys will be removed while other properties remain intact with improved error handling for non-existent keys.

members.name: removeCustomer
members.description: Remove the currently associated customer from the cart, converting it back to a guest cart without customer-specific benefits or information while preserving cart contents.

members.name: removeLineItem
members.description: Remove a specific line item from the cart using its `UUID`. The line item will be completely removed from the cart along with any associated discounts, properties, or selling plans.

members.name: removeLineItemDiscount
members.description: Remove all discounts from a specific line item identified by its `UUID`. This will clear any custom discounts applied to the line item while preserving discount allocation history.

members.name: removeLineItemProperties
members.description: Remove specific properties from a line item by `UUID` and property keys. Only the specified keys will be removed while other properties remain intact with improved error handling.

members.name: removeLineItemSellingPlan
members.description: Remove the selling plan from a line item in the cart using the line item `UUID`. This will clear any subscription or recurring purchase configuration from the line item.

members.name: setAttributedStaff
members.description: Set the attributed staff member for all line items in the cart using the staff `ID`. Pass `undefined` to clear staff attribution from all line items with enhanced staff validation and tracking.

members.name: setAttributedStaffToLineItem
members.description: Set the attributed staff member for a specific line item using the staff `ID` and line item `UUID`. Pass `undefined` as `staffId` to clear attribution from the line item with improved validation and error handling.

members.name: setCustomer
members.description: Associate a customer with the current cart using the customer object containing the customer `ID`. This enables customer-specific pricing, discounts, and checkout features with enhanced customer data validation.

members.name: setLineItemDiscount
members.value: (uuid: string, type: LineItemDiscountType, title: string, amount: string) => Promise<void>
members.description: Apply a discount to a specific line item using its `UUID`. Specify the discount type (`'Percentage'` or `'FixedAmount'`), title, and amount value with improved discount allocation tracking.

members.name: updateDefaultAddress
members.description: Set a specific address as the default address for the customer using the address `ID`. The customer must be present in the cart to update the default address with enhanced validation.

packages/ui-extensions/src/surfaces/poin.name: Address
packages/ui-extensions/src/surfaces/poin.description: Represents physical address information for customer shipping and billing. Contains standard address fields including street, city, region, postal code, and country data.

members.name: address1
members.description: The primary street address line. Required for most shipping and billing operations. Should contain street number and name.

members.name: address2
members.description: The secondary address line for apartment, suite, or unit information. Optional field for additional address details.

members.name: city
members.description: The city name for the address. Required for shipping calculations and location-based services.

members.name: company
members.description: The company name associated with the address. Optional field for business customers and B2B transactions.

members.name: country
members.description: The country name for the address. Required for international shipping, tax calculations, and compliance.

members.name: countryCode
members.description: The standardized country code (ISO format). Use for precise country identification and international shipping operations.

members.name: firstName
members.description: The first name for the address contact. Used for personalized shipping labels and customer communication.

members.name: lastName
members.description: The last name for the address contact. Required for complete customer identification and shipping labels.

members.name: name
members.description: The full name for the address contact. Use when first and last names are combined or unavailable as separate fields.

members.name: phone
members.description: The phone number for the address contact. Used for delivery notifications, shipping updates, and customer communication.

members.name: province
members.description: The province or state name for the address. Required for regional shipping rates and tax calculations.

members.name: provinceCode
members.description: The standardized province or state code. Use for precise regional identification and automated shipping calculations.

members.name: zip
members.description: The postal or ZIP code for the address. Required for accurate shipping rates and location-based services.

packages/ui-extensions/src/surfaces/poin.name: CustomSale
packages/ui-extensions/src/surfaces/poin.description: Represents a custom sale item that is not associated with a product in the catalog. Includes pricing, taxation, and descriptive information for manually created line items.

members.name: price
members.description: The price for the custom sale item as currency string. Must be a valid positive amount. Use for non-catalog items and custom pricing.

members.name: quantity
members.description: The quantity of the custom sale item. Must be a positive integer. Use for quantity-based pricing and inventory management.

members.name: taxable
members.description: Determines whether the custom sale item is taxable. Set to `true` to apply tax calculations, `false` to exempt from taxes.

members.name: title
members.description: The display name for the custom sale item. Appears on receipts and in cart displays. Should be descriptive and customer-friendly.

packages/ui-extensions/src/surfaces/poin.name: SetLineItemSellingPlanInput
packages/ui-extensions/src/surfaces/poin.description: Specifies the parameters for assigning selling plans to line items. Used to add subscription or purchase option configurations to products.

members.name: lineItemUuid
members.description: The target line item `UUID` for selling plan assignment. Must match an existing line item in the cart.

members.name: sellingPlanId
members.description: The selling plan `ID` to apply to the line item. Must be a valid selling plan available for the product.

members.name: sellingPlanName
members.description: The selling plan name for display purposes. Required for proper selling plan display in the cart.

packages/ui-extensions/src/surfaces/poin.name: CartDiscountType
packages/ui-extensions/src/surfaces/poin.value: 'Percentage' | 'FixedAmount' | 'Code'
packages/ui-extensions/src/surfaces/poin.description: Defines the type of discount applied at the cart level. Specifies whether the discount is percentage-based, fixed amount, or discount code redemption.

packages/ui-extensions/src/surfaces/poin.name: SetLineItemPropertiesInput
packages/ui-extensions/src/surfaces/poin.description: Specifies the parameters for adding custom properties to line items. Properties are key-value pairs used for storing metadata, tracking information, or integration data.

members.name: lineItemUuid
members.description: The target line item `UUID` for selling plan assignment. Must match an existing line item in the cart.

members.name: properties
members.description: The custom key-value properties to apply to the line item. Merged with existing properties—duplicate keys overwrite existing values.

packages/ui-extensions/src/surfaces/poin.name: CartUpdateInput
packages/ui-extensions/src/surfaces/poin.description: Specifies the parameters for updating cart information. Includes options for modifying customer data, notes, references, and other cart-level metadata.

members.name: cartDiscount
members.description: The cart-level discount to apply during bulk update. Replaces existing cart discount. Set to `undefined` to remove current discount.

members.name: cartDiscounts
members.description: An array of cart-level discounts to apply during bulk update. Replaces all existing cart discounts with the provided array.

members.name: customer
members.description: The customer to associate with the cart during bulk update. Replaces existing customer or converts guest cart to customer cart.

members.name: lineItems
members.description: An array of line items to set during bulk update. Completely replaces existing cart contents—removes all current items and adds the provided ones.

members.name: note
members.description: The cart note to set during bulk update. Replaces existing note or sets new note if none exists. Set to `undefined` to remove current note.

members.name: properties
members.description: The custom key-value properties to apply to the line item. Merged with existing properties—duplicate keys overwrite existing values.

packages/ui-extensions/src/surfaces/poin.name: Discount
packages/ui-extensions/src/surfaces/poin.description: Represents a discount applied to a cart or transaction, including amount and description.

members.name: amount
members.description: The discount value to apply. For `'Percentage'` type, this represents the percentage value (For example, "10" for 10% off). For `'FixedAmount'` type, this represents the fixed monetary amount to deduct from the line item price. Commonly used for discount calculations and displaying the discount value to merchants.

members.name: currency
members.description: The [ISO 4217](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_4217) currency code associated with the location currently active on POS.

members.name: discountDescription
members.description: A human-readable description of the discount shown to merchants and customers. This typically includes the discount name, promotion details, or discount code (for example, "SUMMER2024", "10% off entire order", "Buy 2 Get 1 Free"). Returns `undefined` when no description is provided.

members.name: type
members.description: The [discount type](https://help.shopify.com/en/manual/discounts/discount-types) applied to this line item. Can be either `'Percentage'` for percentage-based discounts or `'FixedAmount'` for fixed monetary amount discounts. This determines how the discount amount is calculated and displayed.

packages/ui-extensions/src/surfaces/poin.name: Customer
packages/ui-extensions/src/surfaces/poin.description: Represents basic customer identification information. Contains the customer ID for linking to detailed customer data and enabling customer-specific features.

members.name: id
members.description: The unique numeric identifier for the customer in Shopify's system. This ID is consistent across all Shopify systems and APIs. Used to link this customer reference to the full customer record with complete profile information. Commonly used for customer lookups, applying customer-specific pricing or discounts, linking orders to customer accounts, or integrating with customer management systems.

packages/ui-extensions/src/surfaces/poin.name: LineItem
packages/ui-extensions/src/surfaces/poin.description: Represents an individual item in the shopping cart. Contains product information, pricing, quantity, discounts, and customization details for a single cart entry.

members.name: attributedUserId
members.description: The staff member 'ID' attributed to this line item. Returns 'undefined' if no staff attribution is set. Use for commission tracking and performance analytics.

members.name: components
members.description: Bundle components for this line item. Only present for [product bundles](/docs/apps/build/product-merchandising/bundles). Each component represents an individual item within the bundle with its own tax information.

members.name: discountAllocations
members.description: An array of discount allocations applied to this line item, providing detailed breakdown of how discounts are distributed. Returns 'undefined' if no allocations exist. Use for enhanced discount tracking and reporting.

members.name: discounts
members.description: An array of discounts applied to this line item. Empty array if no discounts are active. Use for displaying line item savings and discount details.

members.name: hasSellingPlanGroups
members.description: Determines whether this line item has selling plan groups (subscription options) available. Returns 'undefined' if selling plan information is unavailable. Use for displaying subscription options.

members.name: isGiftCard
members.description: Determines whether this line item is a gift card. Gift cards have special handling requirements and business logic. Use for implementing gift card-specific workflows.

members.name: price
members.description: The unit price of the line item. Returns 'undefined' for custom sales without set prices. Use for pricing calculations and displays.

members.name: productId
members.description: The product 'ID' this line item represents. Returns 'undefined' for custom sales or non-product items. Use for product-specific operations and linking to product details.

members.name: properties
members.description: The custom key-value properties attached to this line item. Empty object if no properties are set. Use for metadata, customization options, or integration data.

members.name: quantity
members.description: The quantity of this item in the cart. Always a positive integer. Use for quantity displays, calculations, and inventory management.

members.name: requiresSellingPlan
members.description: Determines whether this line item requires a selling plan (subscription) to be purchased. Returns 'undefined' if selling plan information is unavailable. Use for implementing subscription-based product handling.

members.name: sellingPlan
members.description: The currently selected selling plan for this line item. Returns 'undefined' if no selling plan is applied. Contains selling plan details including 'ID', name, and delivery intervals. Use for subscription management and recurring purchase functionality.

members.name: sku
members.description: The Stock Keeping Unit (SKU) identifier for this line item. Returns 'undefined' if no SKU is configured. Use for inventory tracking and product identification.

members.name: taxable
members.description: Determines whether this line item is subject to tax calculations. Use for tax computation, compliance, and pricing displays.

members.name: taxLines
members.description: An array of tax lines applied to this line item, containing tax amounts and rates. Use for detailed tax reporting and compliance.

members.name: title
members.description: The display title of the line item. Returns 'undefined' for items without titles. Use for customer-facing displays and cart item identification.

members.name: uuid
members.description: The unique identifier for this line item within the cart. Use for line item-specific operations like updates, removals, or property modifications.

members.name: variantId
members.description: The product variant 'ID' this line item represents. Returns 'undefined' for custom sales or non-variant items. Use for variant-specific operations and product details.

members.name: vendor
members.description: The vendor or brand name for this line item. Returns 'undefined' if no vendor is set. Use for vendor-specific displays and organization.

packages/ui-extensions/src/surfaces/poin.name: LineItemComponent
packages/ui-extensions/src/surfaces/poin.description: Represents a component of a [product bundle](/docs/apps/build/product-merchandising/bundles) line item. Bundle components contain the individual items that make up a bundle, each with their own pricing and tax information.

members.name: price
members.description: The price for the custom sale item as currency string. Must be a valid positive amount. Use for non-catalog items and custom pricing.

members.name: productId
members.description: The unique numeric identifier for the product this component represents, if applicable.

members.name: quantity
members.description: The quantity of the custom sale item. Must be a positive integer. Use for quantity-based pricing and inventory management.

members.name: taxable
members.description: Determines whether the custom sale item is taxable. Set to `true` to apply tax calculations, `false` to exempt from taxes.

members.name: taxLines
members.description: An array of tax lines applied to this component.

members.name: title
members.description: The display name for the custom sale item. Appears on receipts and in cart displays. Should be descriptive and customer-friendly.

members.name: variantId
members.description: The unique numeric identifier for the product variant this component represents, if applicable.

packages/ui-extensions/src/surfaces/poin.name: TaxLine
packages/ui-extensions/src/surfaces/poin.description: Represents a tax line applied to an item or transaction.

members.name: enabled
members.description: Whether this tax is currently enabled.

members.name: price
members.description: The tax amount as a Money object.

members.name: rate
members.description: The tax rate as a decimal number.

members.name: rateRange
members.description: The range of tax rates if applicable.

members.name: title
members.description: The title or name of the tax.

members.name: uuid
members.description: The unique identifier for this tax line.

packages/ui-extensions/src/surfaces/poin.name: Money
packages/ui-extensions/src/surfaces/poin.description: Represents a monetary amount with currency information.

members.name: amount
members.description: The monetary amount as a number.

members.name: currency
members.description: The [ISO 4217](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_4217) currency code associated with the location currently active on POS.

packages/ui-extensions/src/surfaces/poin.name: DiscountAllocation
packages/ui-extensions/src/surfaces/poin.description: Represents the allocation of a discount to a specific line item.

members.name: allocatedAmount
members.description: The amount of discount allocated.

packages/ui-extensions/src/surfaces/poin.name: MoneyV2
packages/ui-extensions/src/surfaces/poin.description: Represents a monetary amount as a string with explicit currency code.

members.name: amount
members.description: The monetary amount as a string.

members.name: currencyCode
members.description: The ISO currency code (for example, USD, CAD).

packages/ui-extensions/src/surfaces/poin.name: SellingPlan
packages/ui-extensions/src/surfaces/poin.description: Represents a selling plan (subscription) associated with a line item, containing delivery schedule and plan identification details.

members.name: deliveryInterval
members.description: The interval of the selling plan. (DAY, WEEK, MONTH, YEAR).

members.name: deliveryIntervalCount
members.description: The number of intervals between deliveries.

members.name: digest
members.description: The fingerprint of the applied selling plan within this cart session. Provided by POS. Not available during refund / exchanges.

members.name: id

members.name: name
members.description: The name of the POS device.

packages/ui-extensions/src/surfaces/poin.name: Cart
packages/ui-extensions/src/surfaces/poin.description: Represents the shopping cart state, including line items, pricing, customer information, and applied discounts. Provides comprehensive access to all cart data and operations.

members.name: cartDiscounts

export interface Storage<
  BaseStorageTypes extends Record<string, any> = Record<string, unknown>,
> {
  /**
   * Stores a value under the specified key, overwriting any existing value. Values must be JSON-serializable and return `StorageError` when storage limits are exceeded. Commonly used for storing user preferences, caching API responses, or passing contextual data from tiles to modals.
   *
   * @param key - The key to set the value for.
   * @param value - The value to set for the key.
   * @throws StorageError when:
   * - Maximum number of records is exceeded (`code: 'RecordsCount'`)
   * - Individual record size exceeds the limit (`code: 'RecordSize'`)
   * - Key is not a string (`code: 'KeyType'`)
   * - Key size exceeds the limit (`code: 'KeySize'`)
   */
  set<
    StorageTypes extends BaseStorageTypes = BaseStorageTypes,
    Keys extends keyof StorageTypes = keyof StorageTypes,
  >(
    key: Keys,
    value: StorageTypes[Keys],
  ): Promise<void>;

  /**
   * Retrieves the value associated with a key, returning `undefined` if the key doesn't exist. Always handle the `undefined` case by providing fallback values or conditional logic. Commonly used for loading user preferences, retrieving cached data, or accessing contextual information passed between extension targets.
   *
   * @param key - The key to get the value for.
   * @returns The value of the key.
   * @throws StorageError when the key isn't a string or exceeds its allotted size.
   */
  get<
    StorageTypes extends BaseStorageTypes = BaseStorageTypes,
    Keys extends keyof StorageTypes = keyof StorageTypes,
  >(
    key: Keys,
  ): Promise<StorageTypes[Keys] | undefined>;

  /**
   * Clears all data from storage, removing all key-value pairs.
   */
  clear: () => Promise<void>;

  /**
   * Deletes a specific key from storage and returns `true` if the key existed, `false` if it didn't exist. Returns `false` for non-existent keys rather than throwing an error. Commonly used for cleaning up temporary workflow data, removing expired cache entries, or handling user preference changes.
   *
   * @param key - The key to delete.
   */
  delete<
    StorageTypes extends BaseStorageTypes = BaseStorageTypes,
    Keys extends keyof StorageTypes = keyof StorageTypes,
  >(
    key: Keys,
  ): Promise<boolean>;

  /**
   * Retrieves all stored key-value pairs as an array of tuples, preserving original data types. Returns all data at once which may impact memory usage with large datasets. Commonly used for debugging storage contents, implementing data export features, or performing bulk operations across stored data.
   *
   * @returns An array containing all the keys and values in the storage.
   */
  entries<
    StorageTypes extends BaseStorageTypes = BaseStorageTypes,
    Keys extends keyof StorageTypes = keyof StorageTypes,
  >(): Promise<[Keys, StorageTypes[Keys]][]>;
}

export interface I18n {
  /**
   * Returns a localized number.
   *
   * This function behaves like the standard `Intl.NumberFormat()`
   * with a style of `decimal` applied. It uses the buyer's locale by default.
   *
   * @param options.inExtensionLocale - if true, use the extension's locale
   */
  formatNumber: (
    number: number | bigint,
    options?: {inExtensionLocale?: boolean} & Intl.NumberFormatOptions,
  ) => string;

  /**
   * Returns a localized currency value.
   *
   * This function behaves like the standard `Intl.NumberFormat()`
   * with a style of `currency` applied. It uses the buyer's locale by default.
   *
   * @param options.inExtensionLocale - if true, use the extension's locale
   */
  formatCurrency: (
    number: number | bigint,
    options?: {inExtensionLocale?: boolean} & Intl.NumberFormatOptions,
  ) => string;

  /**
   * Returns a localized date value.
   *
   * This function behaves like the standard `Intl.DateTimeFormatOptions()` and uses
   * the buyer's locale by default. Formatting options can be passed in as
   * options.
   *
   * @see https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/Intl/DateTimeFormat0
   * @see https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/Intl/DateTimeFormat#using_options
   *
   * @param options.inExtensionLocale - if true, use the extension's locale
   */
  formatDate: (
    date: Date,
    options?: {inExtensionLocale?: boolean} & Intl.DateTimeFormatOptions,
  ) => string;

  /**
   * Returns translated content in the buyer's locale,
   * as supported by the extension.
   *
   * - `options.count` is a special numeric value used in pluralization.
   * - The other option keys and values are treated as replacements for interpolation.
   * - If the replacements are all primitives, then `translate()` returns a single string.
   * - If replacements contain UI components, then `translate()` returns an array of elements.

  translate: I18nTranslate;
}

packages/ui-extensions/src/surfaces/poin.name: Navigation
packages/ui-extensions/src/surfaces/poin.description: The `Navigation` object provides methods for programmatic navigation within modal extensions. Access through the global `navigation` object to navigate between screens, access navigation history, and implement back navigation.

members.name: back
members.description: Navigates to the previous entry in the history list. Use for implementing back buttons, breadcrumb navigation, or allowing users to return to previous screens in multi-step workflows.

members.name: currentEntry
members.description: Returns a `NavigationHistoryEntry` object representing the location the user is currently navigated to. Use to access current URL, navigation state, or implement navigation-aware functionality based on the current location.

members.name: navigate
members.description: Navigates to a specific URL, updating any provided state in the history entries list. Returns a promise that resolves when navigation is complete. Use for programmatic navigation between screens, implementing custom navigation controls, or deep-linking to specific modal states.

packages/ui-extensions/src/surfaces/poin.name: NavigationHistoryEntry
packages/ui-extensions/src/surfaces/poin.description: Represents a single entry in the navigation history stack. Contains the URL and unique identifier for tracking navigation state and implementing history-based navigation.

members.name: getState
members.description: Returns a clone of the available state associated with this history entry. Use to retrieve navigation state data that was passed during navigation or to implement state-based navigation logic.

members.name: key
members.description: A unique, UA-generated value that represents the history entry's slot in the entries list rather than the entry itself. Use for tracking navigation history or implementing navigation-based logic.

members.name: url
members.description: The URL of this history entry. Returns `null` if no URL is associated with the entry. Use for URL-based navigation logic, deep-linking, or displaying current location information.

packages/ui-extensions/src/surfaces/poin.name: NavigationNavigateOptions
packages/ui-extensions/src/surfaces/poin.description: Specifies configuration options for navigation operations. Allows passing state data that persists across navigation transitions.

members.name: state
members.description: Developer-defined information to be stored in the associated `NavigationHistoryEntry` once the navigation is complete, retrievable using `getState()`. Use to pass data between navigation states or implement stateful navigation workflows.

packages/ui-extensions/src/surfaces/poin.name: Window
packages/ui-extensions/src/surfaces/poin.description: The global `window` object provides control over the extension modal lifecycle. Access these properties and methods directly through the global `window` object to manage the modal interface programmatically.

members.name: close
members.description: Closes the extension screen and dismisses the modal interface. Use to programmatically close the modal after completing a workflow, canceling an operation, or when user action is no longer required. This provides the same behavior as the user dismissing the modal through the UI.
